'''The Jagged Place''' was an area in [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]] filled with jagged rocks and bones. It was home to many of the predators in Dagobah, including the [[King of the Dragonsnakes]]. The [[Lair of the King of the Dragonsnakes]] was hidden deep within the Jagged place, where [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was sent to defeat the King of the Dragonsnakes and retrieve it's treasure, the egg of an [[Accipiptero/Legends|Accipiptero]].<ref name="Dragonsnakes" />
